name: LaunchDarkly
description: LaunchDarkly's hosted server reads, creates and updates feature flags and their targeting in your projects.

probe.note: Answers an unauthenticated initialize with 401 and publishes OAuth metadata; the authorization server (app.launchdarkly.com) offers dynamic client registration, so a harness can sign in without a pre-registered app. The sign-in itself was not completed by this check.
